course_phase_rule: the first vertical joint lies course_phase_m[0] along u and the first butt course_phase_m[1] up v from the tile's origin; offset the roof's UV by them to put a butt on the eave
orientation: image x = along the eave (u); image y = up the slope with the top row uphill (v grows upward); each course's butt is its low edge
generation_method: deterministic procedural synthesis (tools/generate_prairie_1904_roofs.py); no photograph sampled
note: Terne (tin-coated iron) in 20 x 28 in sheets joined end to end with a flat cross seam every 28 in, run in 20 in pans between standing seams, painted red oxide. Sheet size, seam and paint are reconstructed; the paint is one of the alternatives listed, and a house's own evidence picks another.
